subject: Marketplace MAP kickoff — GalaxyTech GCP private offer
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tina Huang <tina.huang@galaxytech.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@galaxytech.com>
Cc: procurement@galaxytech.com, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace MAP kickoff — GalaxyTech GCP private offer

Hi Tina / Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our call, I’m kicking off a short mutual action plan so we have clear milestones for the GCP private offer, technical evaluation, and procurement steps. I attached a first-pass MAP (galaxy_mpa_draft.xlsx) that maps the evaluation windows, legal checkpoints, and the marketplace private-offer flow.

High-level ask from my side: can procurement confirm the preferred invoice routing (direct Redwood invoice vs. billed through a cloud reseller) and the internal approval SLA for PO issuance? That determines whether we route through the GCP private-offer flow or prepare a separate reseller agreement.

Proposed next steps (short):
- Technical POC / evaluation: 2 weeks (owner: GalaxyTech eng)
- Security review / SOC2 evidence: parallel (owner: GalaxyTech security)
- Legal & procurement review: 1 week internal review + PO issuance (owner: GalaxyTech procurement)
- Private offer activation via Marketplace: 3–5 business days after countersignature (owner: Redwood + Google Marketplace)

I’ll follow up with a cleaned MAP with owners and target dates once I hear invoice routing and payment terms. If it helps, we can do a 30-minute procurement sync this week.

Attachments: galaxy_mpa_draft.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Tina Huang <tina.huang@galaxytech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@galaxytech.com>
Cc: procurement@galaxytech.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace MAP kickoff — GalaxyTech GCP private offer

Thanks Vivek — this is helpful.

Quick answers:
- Procurement prefers billing routed to our central AR mailbox: accounts.payables@galaxytech.com. They will accept either Redwood invoices or charges billed through an approved reseller; preference is for consolidated monthly billing.
- Payment terms: target Net 45 (we’ll confirm formally in the PO).
- DocuSign is preferred for signature, can you provide the link + MSA?

We’ll run the technical evaluation this week and assign a POC (Samir). I’ve looped procurement (procurement@galaxytech.com) to confirm internal SLA for PO. They may have a short questionnaire — I’ll flag the SOC2 and KMS questions up front.

Can we aim to have a finalized MAP and signed MSA by Fri next week? That would keep the activation window within early September.

Tina Huang
VP, Cloud Platform — GalaxyTech
T: +1 212-555-0199

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace MAP kickoff — internal coordination

Vivek — tagging in Karthik and Priyom for procurement/legal alignment. A couple of internal notes to tighten the MAP before we send the MSA/DocuSign:

1) Pricing and commit tiers: confirm whether GalaxyTech plans to commit to a reserved capacity tier or start on hosted with monthly usage. If they commit, we need the commit level to prepare the private-offer SKU.
2) Billing path: if they prefer consolidated monthly billing via CloudBridge (reseller), we need reseller ID and PO info to stitch to the marketplace private-offer.
3) MSA redlines: I’ll attach our standard MSA (redwood_msa.pdf) and ask Legal to pre-clear the commercial terms for Net45 exceptions.

I’ll prepare mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx with owners/dates; Vivek, can you confirm the target sign-by date? Tina suggested Fri next week which seems feasible if procurement moves quickly.

Laura
Director, Commercial Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tina Huang <tina.huang@galaxytech.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@galaxytech.com>
Cc: procurement@galaxytech.com, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace MAP kickoff — GalaxyTech GCP private offer (MAP v2 + steps)

Tina / team —

Attached is mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx and our standard MSA (redwood_msa.pdf). I’ve sketched a pragmatic timeline below with owners and dates to match the targets you mentioned:

Mutual Action Plan (condensed)
- 8/26 — Technical POC kickoff (owner: GalaxyTech — Samir)
- 8/27 — SOC2 + security checklist sent (owner: Redwood — Priyom) [attachment: procurement_questions.pdf]
- 8/27–8/31 — Legal review & PO draft (owner: GalaxyTech procurement)
- 9/1 — Countersign via DocuSign (target) — DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/GLX-2026-0921
- 9/2–9/6 — Marketplace private-offer activation (3–5 business days after countersign)
- 9/7 — Activation verification & first billing period start (owner: Redwood + GalaxyTech finance)

Notes on billing path: if GalaxyTech confirms CloudBridge as reseller, Redwood will submit the private-offer request including reseller ID so billing flows to CloudBridge. If they prefer Redwood invoices directly, we’ll prepare an AR route to accounts.payables@galaxytech.com with Net45 terms. Please confirm reseller contact or preference.

For legal redlines: we’re open to the standard Net45 note — Laura has started a commercial pre-review and Legal can fast-track if needed.

I’ll schedule a 30-minute procurement sync for Thur 8/28 at 10am PT — invite to follow.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx, redwood_msa.pdf, procurement_questions.pdf

Thanks —
Vivek

From: procurement@galaxytech.com <procurement@galaxytech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Tina Huang <tina.huang@galaxytech.com>
Cc: accounts.payables@galaxytech.com
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: GalaxyTech procurement questions — Redwood private-offer

Vivek / Tina —

We reviewed the MAP and MSA. A few procurement items before we can issue a PO: 

1) Finance needs Net45 noted on the MSA (we propose an addendum).
2) Please provide SOC2 Type II evidence and the KMS encryption policy (we’ll accept a vendor package or link).
3) Confirm whether billing will come from: a) Redwood Inference directly to accounts.payables@galaxytech.com, or b) CloudBridge Solutions (reseller) — if b, provide reseller ID and Master Reseller Agreement.
4) DocuSign link is fine; please send final MSA with Net45 addendum for signature.

Attached: procurement_questions.pdf (list of questions + vendor checklist).

Once we receive SOC2 and the MSA addendum, we’ll aim to issue a PO within 3 business days.

Procurement — GalaxyTech

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: procurement@galaxytech.com, Tina Huang <tina.huang@galaxytech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: GalaxyTech procurement questions — Redwood private-offer (next steps)

Thanks — quick update and confirmatory notes: 

- We’ll produce a one-page Net45 addendum to attach to the MSA and send via DocuSign by tomorrow morning.
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted) and KMS summary will be provided via secure link this afternoon.
- CloudBridge is an approved reseller; Tina confirmed they prefer consolidated billing via CloudBridge. Reseller contact: reseller@cloudbridge.com — we’ll include the reseller ID in the private-offer request.
- Target: PO issuance by 8/31; DocuSign complete by 9/1; marketplace activation the week of 9/2 pending marketplace processing.

I’ll post the DocuSign link and the secure SOC2 link to the HubSpot deal and follow up right away. We’ll also run the procurement sync today at 3pm PT to unblock anything urgent.

Thanks everyone —
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
